name: com.pakeesim/esim
title: Pakeesim eSIM
description: Travel data eSIMs for 80+ countries: live prices and availability, order online, get the QR code.

tools.name: cari_paket
tools.description: Search Pakeesim's live catalogue of prepaid travel data eSIMs (prices in IDR, live sale prices and availability). Use it when the user asks for eSIM or travel data plans for a destination. `tujuan` is free text in any language: a country, city or region, optionally with days and data ("Japan 7 days 3GB", "eSIM Jepang seminggu", "日本 5日間", "eSIM Europa 15 días", "유럽 2주"). Returns `saran` (cheapest available plan covering the stated days/data), then plans in recommended order: the country's own plans, then regional and Global plans that also cover it. Without `tujuan` and filters: one line per destination with plan count and lowest price.

tujuan.description: Destination and needs in the user's own words, any language.

kuotaMinGb.description: Only plans with at least this much data (GB).

masaAktifMinHari.description: Only plans valid for at least this many days.

hargaMaksIdr.description: Only plans at or below this price (IDR).

bahasa.description: Label language: id (Indonesian, default) or en.

tools.name: detail_paket
tools.description: Full details of one plan by slug: live price and sale end, data, validity, every covered country, network, description, device requirements and links to installation and refund policy.

bahasa.description: Label language: id (Indonesian, default) or en.

tools.name: promo_berjalan
tools.description: Sales running right now (flash sales and discounts), grouped by data/validity, with sale price, normal price, percent saved, start and end time and which destinations they apply to.

bahasa.description: Label language: id (Indonesian, default) or en.

tools.name: hitung_harga
tools.description: Exact price breakdown before ordering, without creating an order: unit price (with any running sale), subtotal for the quantity, promo code check and discount, total to pay, and whether the plan can be ordered in that quantity.

kodePromo.description: Promo code the user gave you, if any.

email.description: Optional: buyer's email, to check per-email code limits.

bahasa.description: Label language: id (Indonesian, default) or en.

tools.name: cek_perangkat
tools.description: Checks a phone/tablet model against Pakeesim's eSIM device reference list (e.g. "iPhone 13", "Galaxy S23", "Redmi Note 13") and returns a verdict, notes for that brand, and how the user can confirm on the device itself. It is a reference, not a guarantee: support depends on the variant and market.

bahasa.description: Label language: id (Indonesian, default) or en.

tools.name: info_checkout
tools.description: Returns the active online payment methods (use `id` as `metodePembayaran`; an empty list means online payment is temporarily unavailable), the exact consent statement and device requirements the user must accept, the maximum quantity and the order expiry.

bahasa.description: Label language: id (Indonesian, default) or en.

tools.name: buat_pesanan
tools.description: Creates an order for the user and emails them the order link. Only call this after the user chose the plan and explicitly confirmed this statement: "I have checked: my phone supports eSIM and is not carrier-locked (SIM Lock). I understand this eSIM is for internet only — no phone number, texts, or calls — and cannot be topped up." No money moves yet: the user pays online on their order page at pakeesim.com (payment gateway), and the result has the amount and that link (`pembayaran.tautanBayar`). Send a `kunciIdempotensi` so a retried call returns the same order instead of a duplicate. Limited to a few orders per email per 10 minutes.

email.description: Buyer's email; the order link and QR code are sent here.

metodePembayaran.description: Optional online payment method id from info_checkout. Omit it to use the first listed method.

kodePromo.description: Optional promo code the user gave you.

setujuKompatibel.description: true only if the user confirmed their phone supports eSIM and is not carrier-locked.

kunciIdempotensi.description: Optional unique key for this purchase (e.g. a UUID). Repeating the call with the same key, email and plan returns the same order for 24 hours.

bahasa.description: Label language: id (Indonesian, default) or en.

tools.name: cek_pesanan
tools.description: Returns an order's status, the next step, payment details, and — once delivered — the eSIM profiles (LPA QR payload, SM-DP+ address, activation code).

token.description: Access token from buat_pesanan (the `t` in the order URL).

bahasa.description: Label language: id (Indonesian, default) or en.
